title: FA/15/2004 of OIL and NATURAL GAS CORP. LTD. Vs SMT. MITHLESH SINGHAL and ANR.

paras.text:
MCC No. 445 of 2009
 IN
F.A. No. 15 of 2004
Hon. Prafulla C. Pant, J.

Shri Sudhir Kumar, Advocate holding brief of Shri J.P. Joshi,
Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Ashok Agarwal, Advocate for the respondents.
 This is application MCC No. 445 of 2009, moved by respondents,
praying that amount deposited in this Court be sent back to the court of
District Judge, Dehradun, so that the claimant may withdraw the amount.
 Heard.
 This appeal was decided vide order dated 05.08.2005. An amount of
Rs. 2,49,641/- which was deposited in this Court is reported to have been
sent to District Judge, Dehradun on 14.02.2006, through demand draft No.
0459268996, dated 11.02.2006, as per the office report.
 In view of the above report, there is no further direction needed to
be made for remitting the amount.
 Therefore, application MCC No. 445 of 2009, stands disposed of with
the observation, as above.
 Record be consigned to record room.
